label: Via MAXIME_3 (strictly greatest), a MAXIME_1 being causes being in all others
description: MAXIME_3 branch: some being is STRICTLY greatest in being; such a being causes being in every other being; and the explicit sense bridge says a STRICTLY greatest being is MAXIMAL in being. So some MAXIMAL being causes being in every other being. Its existence premise is stronger than MAXIME_1's: the tied control has a MAXIMAL being and no STRICTLY greatest one.
